title: Built a game using Ai tools
author: Doughnuts2312
selftext:
So I built Apple Gravity 🎮

Game link- https://gravity-bucket.emergent.host/

Draw your own container in 25 seconds, then catch as many falling apples as you can. Your drawing becomes part of the game, your score gets saved, and you can even play with containers created by other players.
